description: The plot illustrates the maximum activation values across different layers for four distinct components: `attn_output`, `attn_residual`, `ffn_output`, and `ffn_residual`. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5, and the y-axis represents the maximum activation value, scaled from 0 to 1600. The `attn_output` (blue dashed line) remains near zero until layer 5, then rises sharply to approximately 200 at layer 22. The `attn_residual` (orange dotted line) begins at 0, increases rapidly to about 1400 at layer 5, and then stabilizes around 1500 until layer 20, after which it drops to 300 at layer 22. The `ffn_output` (green dash-dotted line) shows a sharp increase from 0 to 1200 at layer 5, then decreases to 0 at layer 10, rises again to 900 at layer 13, and finally drops to 0 at layer 22. The `ffn_residual` (red solid line) starts at 0, increases sharply to 1400 at layer 5, remains stable around 1500 until layer 20, and then drops to 600 at layer 22.
